Senses.Explanation: To make the formal greeting is to perform the conventional monastic salutation and inquiry after another’s well-being. The monastic rules prescribe it during travel and arrival; Linji Yixuan and Fayan Wenyi then make the greeting’s timing part of encounters, and Kapimala's biography, after his reception of the teaching from Asvaghosa, records the same visible act. It is more specific than any casual question.
